reason: Most of my collabs are free food and products, so there's no rate to negotiate and no payment to chase. I might try the free scam check on the sketchy DMs, but I wouldn't pay for Pro or hand over 5% of deals I barely get.
objection: It's a beta with a small team and I don't know who's behind it. If a brand ghosts me on payment, is Mitra actually going to do anything, or just send a polite reminder? And I'm not sure I want an app sending messages from my account.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually turned one of my barter offers into a paid deal, and I could see the real company behind it with a support number in Bengaluru, I'd pay the ₹199.
